newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai stock turnover surges in first 10 months.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai stock turnover surges in first 10 months.

text.p: Turnover on the Shanghai stock exchange surged to 2.014 trillion yuan in the first 10 months of this year, more than three times the figure for the whole of 1995, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.
Combined turnover of stocks, funds and treasury bonds on the bourse in 1995 was 5.462 billion yuan.

The major increases came from turnover in stocks, which rose 113.94 percent to 602.03 billion yuan in the first 10 months of the year against the same 1995 period, and turnover of treasury bonds, which rocketed by a year-on-year 770 percent to 1.314 trillion yuan, the newspaper said.

It said the increases were mainly due to improvements in China's economy, two bank interest rate cuts this year and policy support from the city government, including supplying more loans to listed firms.
